issue.description:
ADR-001 (Accepted) commits bead-rs to a third dependency kind `verifies` and an advisory inverted-verification-gate diagnosis, explicitly deferred to post-0.1 as R025, and no open bead tracks it — the two-kind set of section 3.4 is still all that ships, while the ADR records 21 and 24 inverted edges in live workspaces (4-6% of new beads) as a recurring authoring error bead-rs currently cannot see. Implement: extend dependency validation and storage to accept `verifies` alongside `blocks`; keep cycle rejection on `blocks` and decide/document whether `verifies` participates in readiness (it must not enter the eligibility query); extend the CLI (dep add / manifest), checkpoint serialization, and unknown-field-safe round trips for the new kind; implement the structural detector (a blocks edge whose blocker verifies its blocked bead) as an advisory doctor/policy-lint report that never rejects at insert time and never infers from titles; add dependency-mutation concurrency tests for the new kind, conformance coverage, and field-guide/schema-explain entries.
